plan.notes: BA in Classics. Official Monmouth College 'Academic Plan' (sample plan). One Monmouth course credit = 4 credit-hours; credits modeled in Monmouth course credits exactly as printed. The plan places major courses and first-year Core Foundations; remaining credits each term are filled with Core Requirements or general electives per the plan's instructions (those fillers are not modeled). Italics in the source indicate prerequisites exist - see the catalog for chains; not modeled here. 'Or' rows occupying one slot are modeled as single choice slots. Flexible 'take in either term' rows are modeled in the first-listed term and documented. Pages undated (retrieved 2026-10-09); catalog_year labeled 2026-2027. This plan is a minimal skeleton: major elective slots are printed as 0.25-1 cr and modeled at the 0.25 minimum (template total 9.0). The Requirements page requires 7.0 credits in Latin/Greek languages plus 2.0 more in LATN/GREK 300/400-level courses - students fill the elective slots accordingly with advisor guidance.
